statement: OpenCode's pinned tool registry combines built-in, custom, plugin, and MCP tool definitions, filters their visibility through Agent permission rules, validates adapter-facing arguments, and routes execution through registered handlers with normalized output metadata.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 OpenCode tool registry 合并 built-in、custom、plugin 与 MCP 工具定义，按 Agent permission rule 过滤可见性，验证 adapter-facing 参数，并通过已注册 handler 执行且规范化输出 metadata。
display_text.en: OpenCode's pinned tool registry combines built-in, custom, plugin, and MCP definitions, permission-filters visibility, validates arguments, and dispatches registered handlers with normalized output metadata.

evidence.title: OpenCode tool registry
evidence.locator: Registry service, resolve, and tool execute wrappers
